name: IBY_SYS_PMT_PROFILES_B
description: IBY_SYS_PMT_PROFILES stores seeded information that specifies the bulk of payment processing behavior. The rest of the behavior is specified in a user-defined account payment process profile stored in IBY_ACCT_PMT_PROFILES. A combination of the two tables is defined in the view IBY_PAYMENT_PROFILES. The payment process profile as a whole controls the behavior of the payment process. To create a payment process profile, the user specifies how the payment instruction should be formatted, how it should be transmitted, how its acknowledgment and clearing files should be handled by the system, and other relevant information. This table corresponds to the Payment Process Profile pages.
